principles: life-safety concerns use human emergency/welfare-check authority
all master-key use is staff-controlled and audited

routine_delivery.contactless_rule: Only for non-sensitive items and only when guest requested/confirmed drop-off location.

dnd.first_step: send in-app/phone message or call guest
dnd.second_step: one additional contact attempt; keep request pending
dnd.welfare_concern_outcome: human Duty Manager/Security welfare-check process; kiosk cannot authorize entry

guest_answer_policy: May explain the conservative demo procedure only if clearly labeled as prototype policy.
